name: Building Sandbox [🔨]
desc:
Welcome to Building Sandbox

💾 Your builds save in FREE private servers!

🏗️ Build anything you can imagine — from tiny houses to massive cities!
🔨 Create epic bases, castles, farms, and crazy inventions!
🌎 Explore your creations and turn your ideas into reality!
👥 Build together with your friends in FREE private servers!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite the game if you enjoy it!
